videos.title: From GSoC Rejection to Mentor: Lessons for GSoC 2027
videos.description: Rejected from GSoC in 2024, a contributor at stdlib in 2025, a mentor in 2026: the lessons for GSoC 2027.
summary: I got rejected from Google Summer of Code in 2024. In 2025 I was a GSoC contributor at stdlib, and in 2026 I was a GSoC mentor there. This is that story, plus the lessons I'd give anyone preparing for GSoC 2027.

I talk about why my first application fell short, how I picked an organization, the mistake I made by opening a batch of near-identical PRs in two days, the contribution that finally made me stand out (a benchmark fix that had no issue), and how contributing turned into mentoring.
